sources.title: Phnom Penh Post, 31 Dec 2008: Decree creates three new provinces
sources.says: Royal decree of 22 Dec 2008 makes Kep, Sihanoukville and Pailin provinces and re-demarcates Battambang/Pursat and Sihanoukville/Koh Kong boundaries.

sources.title: Statoids: Provinces of Cambodia, change history
sources.says: 2008-12-22 decree: Kep, Pailin, Preah Sihanouk become provinces; boundary adjustments only between Battambang/Pursat and Preah Sihanouk/Koh Kong; next change 2013 (Tbong Khmum).
